title: Recipe 27 — Federation (crew handoff that crosses a deployment boundary)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Federation is crew handoff that crosses a deployment boundary — mTLS, cert pinning, one trace across two hosts.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed starter is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env for symmetry with every other drive. Nothing below actually needs it.

verify.note: operator-supplied demos/.env; every proof beat here is hermetic

groups.title: Beat 1 · the shape federation extends — crew on one host

beats.label: Type the crew header
beats.cue: “Start where the recipe says to start: recipe 04's crew. Three roles, one deployment.”

beats.label: Add the researcher
beats.cue: “The entry role. It lists risks, then hands off — by name, in-process.”

beats.label: Add the writer
beats.cue: “Handoff lands here. SendMessage lets it ask the critic a question mid-turn.”

beats.label: Add the critic
beats.cue: “Three roles that trust each other because they share a process. Federation is what you reach for when they can't.”

beats.label: Lint the crew spec
beats.cue: “Clean — and note what is not in here: there is no federation block to lint. The spec schema has no such field.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “Three roles, one orchestrator. Every edge in that IR is in-process.”

verify.note: prints the IR for target crew

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check asserts the shape, installs the deps, and boots it: GREEN, no key needed.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok (4 anchors); install ok; boot gated at the stdin input gate

beats.label: Open the emitted orchestrator
beats.cue: “Handoff is a function call in here. Crossing a host boundary is the part the bundle cannot do for you.”

groups.title: Beat 3 · the bytes on the wire

beats.label: Type the federation envelope
beats.cue: “This is the whole protocol surface — a versioned envelope with the caller's traceparent riding along.”

beats.label: Open the envelope
beats.cue: “Read where the identities live: only inside federation.from and federation.to. There is no top-level from.”

beats.label: Assert the envelope's invariants
beats.cue: “Strict version, and identities only under federation.* — the two things a receiver fails closed on.”
beats.command: bun -e 'const e=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("live/envelope.json","utf8")); if(e.version!=="crewhaus.federation.v1") throw new Error("version must match exactly"); if("from" in e || "fromRole" in e) throw new Error("identities belong under federation.from/to"); console.log("envelope ok: "+e.kind+" "+e.federation.from.deployment+"/"+e.federation.from.role+" -> "+e.federation.to.deployment+"/"+e.federation.to.role)'

beats.label: Type the discovered PeerRecord
beats.cue: “Discovery returns this from .well-known/crewhaus.json — endpoint, version, shapes, and the leaf fingerprint the router pins.”

beats.label: Hold the PeerRecord to the pin rule
beats.cue: “https only, version strict, fingerprint exactly 64 hex. The recipe prints a placeholder — so watch it fail the pin rule.”
beats.command: bun -e 'const p=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("live/peer-record.json","utf8")); if(!p.endpoint.startsWith("https://")) throw new Error("endpoint must be https"); if(p.version!=="crewhaus.federation.v1") throw new Error("strict version"); console.log("endpoint https: ok; version strict: ok; 64-hex fingerprint: "+/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(p.publicKeyFingerprint)+" (a placeholder — discovery fails closed on it)")'

verify.note: prints 64-hex fingerprint: false — the recipe's abc...<64-char hex> placeholder is rejected by the pin rule

beats.label: Ask the CLI to find the peer
beats.cue: “discover is the only federation verb the CLI exposes. Point it at a peer that isn't there — deliberate rejection, exit 1.”

verify.note: deliberate rejection — `federation discover: peer discovery failed for deployment-b.example`; .example never resolves

beats.label: Read the recovery taxonomy
beats.cue: “Network error retries, a 503 retries — but a cert-pin mismatch tombstones. Retry cannot fix a trust failure.”

verify.note: 5 lines — the import plus probe D's four taxonomy assertions

groups.title: One more thing · the smoke is the demo

beats.label: Run the two-deployment fixture
beats.cue: “Six probes: envelope round-trip, discovery TTL, router happy path, taxonomy, and a live in-process peer. No docker, no key.”

verify.note: probes A–E all green; probe F skipped without CREWHAUS_FEDERATION_LIVE=1

beats.label: Read the spec-integration gap
beats.cue: “Say this out loud: there is no federation field in crewhaus.yaml today. You compose the three packages in deployment code.”
